observations: Single photo shows a blue folding fat-tire bicycle with alloy mag wheels, disc brakes, front suspension fork, placed on artificial grass against a tiled wall backdrop
A watermark reading 'Sunny Best Sports' appears in the bottom right corner of the photo, suggesting this is a store/stock catalogue image rather than a personal snapshot
Tire sidewall has partially legible text that may read 'MAGISI' or similar, not clearly readable
No accessories (lock, pump, lights, bag) are visible in the frame despite the claim of 'complete accessories'
No close-up of gears, brake calipers, frame joints, or folding hinge is provided

claims.claim: Big tire bicycle with complete accessories
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows only the bicycle itself on grass; no accessories (pump, lock, lights, etc.) are visible anywhere in the frame
No purchase receipt, date-stamped photo, or personal usage context shown; image appears to be a watermarked store photo, not a personal photo of a used item
No video or close-up showing gear shifting or brake function; only a static side-view photo
Image resolution and distance do not allow close inspection of frame welds, spokes, or hidden areas for rust
No brand/model markings clearly legible on frame, gears, or brake components to confirm originality

risks.risk: Photo may be a stock/catalogue image rather than the actual item being sold, given the visible store watermark
risks.proof: A fresh photo of the actual bicycle taken by the seller in current location, with a handwritten note/date or timestamp visible
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified identity/condition, treat listing with suspicion

risks.risk: Gear and brake functionality cannot be confirmed from a static photo
risks.proof: Short video clip showing gear shifting through range and brake lever engagement with wheel stopping

risks.risk: Hidden rust or frame damage not visible at this distance/angle
risks.proof: Close-up photos of frame joints, fork, chain, and underside of the bike
Photo of all included accessories laid out together with the bike
risks.if_unproven: priced as bike only, no accessories

risks.risk: Folding mechanism (hinge) integrity unknown, common failure point on folding bikes
risks.proof: Video of the bike being folded and unfolded
risks.if_unproven: priced as hinge condition unknown/worst case

proof_requests: A new, seller-taken photo of the actual bicycle (not a watermarked store image) in its current location
Video showing gears shifting, brakes engaging, and the folding hinge in use
Close-up photos of frame welds, fork, and underside for rust/damage check
Photo of all accessories included in the sale laid out together
Any proof of purchase or original packaging
response.reason: The single photo carries a third-party store watermark ('Sunny Best Sports'), which strongly suggests a stock/catalogue image rather than a personal photo of a 6-month-old used bicycle, directly undermining the seller's ownership and condition claims.
